newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S. Megga places 114 mln new shares.
newsitem.headline: S. Megga places 114 mln new shares.

text.p: S. Megga International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it would issue 114 million new shares to substantial shareholder Fook Man Development Co Ltd, raising net proceeds of HK$61.8 million for working capital.
S. Megga said Fook Man had agreed to place 114 million existing company shares at HK$0.55 per share before it subscribed the same amount of new shares at the net placing price after expenses.
On completion of the deal, Fook Man's stake in S. Megga will be diluted to 20.6 percent from 24.7 percent, the company said.
S. Megga makes telecommunications products including cordless and feature telephones and facsimile machines.
Its shares were HK$0.02 higher at HK$0.67 in morning trade on Friday.
